standard-dialogue.npc: Well hello, come in, come in, my name's Hadley, I'm head of tourism here. There's some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor here. People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the

Surely pretty is an understatement, [sir./lady./.] Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.

options.text: What happened to the elven king?

steps.player: What happened to the elven king?

steps.npc: Baxtorian? I guess he died a long long time ago, it's quite sad really. After leaving his kingdom to deal with invading forces, Baxtorian returned to find his wife Glarial had been captured by the enemy.

This destroyed Baxtorian, after years of searching he became a recluse. He went into the secret home he had made for Glarial under the waterfall and sealed himself in. To this day, no one has managed to enter.

options.text: Where else is worth visiting around here?

steps.player: Where else is worth visiting around here?

steps.npc: Well, there's a wide variety of wildlife, although unfortunately most of it's quite dangerous. Please don't feed the goblins.
There is a lovely spot for a picnic on the hill to the north east, there's a monument to the elven queen Glarial. It really is quite pretty.

options.text: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!

steps.player: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!

People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the beautiful hillsides.

Surely pretty is an understatement, [sir./lady./.] Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.

after-learning-about-the-treasure-during.text: If the player has the Book on Baxtorian in their inventory:

steps.npc: I hope you're enjoying your stay, there should be lots of useful infomation in that book you've got. Make sure you give it a read.

options.text: Is there treasure under the waterfall?

steps.player: Is there treasure under the waterfall?

steps.npc: Ha ha... Another treasure hunter. Well if there is no one's been able to get to it. They've been searching that river for decades, all to no avail.
